description:
Get a contact's profile picture, or the reason there is none.

The answer carries `kind`: `available` with a temporary URL, or
`unavailable` with a reason. `no_storage` means the organization has not configured object
storage, which is a setup step rather than a fault with this contact.
The person may also simply have no picture, or have hidden it in their
privacy settings.

number_alias.description: Which of the organization's WhatsApp numbers this acts on: `main`, the alias of an extra number, or the number's `id` (`num_…`), which stays the same when the alias is renamed. Call `list_numbers` to see them. Defaults to the main number.
number_alias.title: Number Alias
